text:
felix: quick review pls  new compact legend for roles in the invite drawer. goal: show origin (direct/team/org), SSO, and a one-click audit shortcut without blowing up width. figma: https://figma.redwood.app/file/compact-legend-v1

anya: looks solid. two quick Qs: how will this behave on narrow phones? and what verb are we using for the primary CTA?

sam: mobile: keep a single-line summary and collapse extras into a '+N' affordance that opens a small popover. CTA verb: propose 'Set role' here to avoid confusion with other flows that use 'Add'.

kevin: accessibility items: 1) ensure the '+N' control is tabbable before kebab; 2) SSO marker needs aria-label 'SSO required' and contrast >=4.5:1; 3) badge shortforms (e.g., 'Via') must have full aria-text.

mei: microcopy nit: 'Via' may be unclear in some locales. Recommend tokenizing short form as `roles.source_short` so translations can pick a locale-appropriate short word.

felix: decision candidates: A) compact legend shows primary role + up to 1 badge (Via: X) + SSO icon; B) '+N' expands full list; C) inline 'Audit' link for rows with recent role events; D) use 'Set role' for CTA in drawer. objections?

sam: good. one impl note: we already get membership.sources in payload, so client-side formatting only. will avoid extra backend calls.

kevin: focus management: when '+N' opens, set focus to first item in the popover and return focus to '+N' on close. avoid trapping beyond the popover. ensure screen readers only read the popover content (swap aria-describedby).

mei: CSS suggestion for spec: `.sso-badge { background:#07293f; color:#fff; padding:3px 6px; border-radius:6px } .more-pill { min-width:32px; }` and `:focus-visible { outline-offset:3px }`.

felix: I'll update figma and the spec with tokens and aria strings. target: dev PR on staging by end of sprint. tagging @sam for estimate and @kevin for a11y signoff.

bot-a11y: Created ticket UX-5098 with checklist: a11y labels, keyboard order, contrast, i18n tokens.

anya: tiny addendum  make the inline 'Audit' opt-in only when `lastRoleChange <= 30d` to avoid noise. also prefer shorter visual 'SSO' with aria-label for screen readers.

sam: noted. will include conditional audit link and aria copy in acceptance criteria.

kevin: one last nit  test with NVDA/VoiceOver to ensure the popover doesn't get announced twice (badge + popover). swap aria-describedby when popover is visible.

felix: thanks all. closing unless blockers. :thumbsup:
